settings.title: Frequently asked
settings.text: Add your answers in the theme editor. Only publish information that reflects your actual policies.

settings.question: How does the discovery set work?
settings.answer: Choose any four of our fragrances. Each arrives as a 12ml miniature, so you can wear them over days before committing to a full bottle.

settings.question: What is the difference between top, heart and base notes?
settings.answer: Top notes are the first impression after spraying, heart notes form the character as the fragrance settles, and base notes are the deep, lasting trail.

settings.question: Where do you ship, and how long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Please see our shipping policy for current coverage and timelines.

settings.question: Can I return a fragrance?
settings.answer: Please see our refund policy for the exact conditions.

settings.title: Still curious?
settings.text: Our team is happy to help you find your fragrance.
